features: Multi-Language Lyrics Anti-Collision Engine: Intelligently detects song languages (Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada) and blocks incorrect cross-language lyrics
Apple Music Story Sharing Suite: 16 handcrafted templates with transparent full Zenify logo branding and native Instagram, WhatsApp & Snapchat sharing
Streamlined Story Sharing Suite architecture with buttery smooth rasterization

Ensured full authentic transparent Zenify logo is rendered on all shared stories without artificial plain text letters
Language-scoped multi-query search fallback with candidate score weighting in LRCLIB and lrc.red
improvements: Freshly built v1.0.10 (Build 14) ultra-compressed ARM64 & Universal APKs
Optimized lyrics memory and persistent disk caching for instantaneous line-synced display
